title: docs: the organization-ownership passages say what 18.0 supports for a v17 database
body:
Fixes #24653
Refs #24637 (the 18.0 release-text family parent; this PR is its `domain:devx` row and leaves the parent open)
Clause-②: no — docs prose only; no authorable key, flag, exit code or JSON key moves.

Four hand-written pages walked an operator through `os migrate organization-ownership` plan and apply with no 18.0 qualifier, and 18.0 refuses that command on every database (`NOT_IMPLEMENTED`). Each passage now does one of the two things the card's Done line allows, in the terms PR #24635 landed (`f89d29e382`):

- **(a)** where it tells an 18.0 reader what happens now: "18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path."
- **(b)** where it teaches the ceremony's mechanics (plan, apply, the drop gate's way on): the mechanics stay, under an explicit "In the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path" qualifier.

Docs only: no package code, no new gate, label `skip-changeset` (see Changeset).

## Census

`git grep -n -E "organization-ownership (--apply|--out|--dev)|--plan-file" -- content/docs` — 8 hits at `BASE` `bfc1539fe0`, 8 hits at head `d989786746`. Every hit after the change sits under an (a) or (b) sentence:

| before | after | passage | choice | the sentence it sits under |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx:109` | `:109` | ADR-0131 D6 overlay note: a v18 `os serve` refuses a database still holding an organization overlay row | (a) + (b) | the landed sentence verbatim, then "In that release, the v18 migration ceremony (ADR-0131 C7: `--out PLAN`, then `--apply --plan-file PLAN`) carries such a row to the environment layer…" |
| `deployment/cli.mdx:213` | `:220` | `os dev`, step 2 (`organization-ownership --dev`) | (b), under an (a) callout | callout `:205–213` ("18.0 does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path", plus what `os dev` does in 18.0); the steps open with "In the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path, `os dev` runs that ceremony for you…" (`:215`) |
| `deployment/cli.mdx:1029` | `:1047` | `os migrate apply --allow-destructive`, the `organization_id` drop gate | (a) + (b) | `:1043–1046`: "18.0 itself never records a verified run, so on a v17 database this refusal holds on every run." plus the landed sentence verbatim; then "In that release, the ceremony's `--apply --plan-file FILE` run drops these columns itself…" |
| `deployment/cli.mdx:1492` | `:1507` | the ceremony's fence, `--out plan.json` | (b), under the (a) callout | callout `:1498–1504`: refused in 18.0 with `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, "Keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path. The invocations below, and what the list after them says the ceremony does, are that 18.x release's." |
| `deployment/cli.mdx:1493` | `:1508` | the fence, `--apply --plan-file plan.json --backup-taken` | (b) | the same callout |
| `deployment/cli.mdx:1494` | `:1509` | the fence, `--dev …` | (b) | the same callout |
| `permissions/capabilities.mdx:220` | `:223` | what `--apply` does with `sys_capability` rows | (b) | `:220–222`: "In the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path (18.0 does not upgrade a v17 database: see `os migrate organization-ownership`)", linking the CLI page's callout |
| `permissions/permission-sets.mdx:399` | `:402` | what `--apply` does with `sys_permission_set` rows | (b) | `:399–401`: the same qualifier and link |

Other edits inside the same passages:

- Heading `A 17.x development database is upgraded in place` is now `A 17.x development database`: in 18.0 nothing is upgraded. Nothing in the repo links the old anchor (`git grep` over `content`, `apps`, `docs`: 0 hits), and `check:doc-anchors` is green.
- `os serve` / `os start`: "they refuse and name the command" is now "they refuse to start, and on a v17 database their 18.0 refusal says that 18.0 does not upgrade it". The runtime boot refusal's v17-shape branch (`organizationOwnershipRefusalMessage`, `packages/runtime/src/organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts`) says "18.0 does not upgrade a v17 database: keep this one on a 17.x release…" at `BASE`. It also still names the 18.x steps, which is the `domain:cli` row (#24651), so this sentence holds whichever way that row lands.
- The `os migrate organization-ownership` intro: "Under `os dev` it runs on its own" now carries the 18.x qualifier.
- The drop gate's population. The page said "These tables are the ADR-0131 D7 tables and the `sys_metadata` family", which is narrower than the code: `ceremonyOrganizationColumnDrops` (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-drop-gate.ts`) holds back every `drop_column organization_id` in the intended drift, its header says why ("the ceremony plans each table that carries the column"), and PR #24635 measured an application object (`acme_note` with `systemFields: { tenant: false }`) refused by it. The page now says "on every table the drift offers to drop it from: the ceremony plans every table that still carries the column, the ADR-0131 D7 tables and the `sys_metadata` family among them".

## The two facts, measured at `BASE`

- **The drop gate still withholds the drops.** `MigrateApply.run()` (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts:555–611`): when the intended drift holds an `organization_id` drop and `readOrganizationOwnershipMarker` answers not verified, it refuses the whole `--allow-destructive` run, exit 1 (`--json`: `message: refused_organization_ownership_unmigrated`, `tables`, `detail`, `marker`). Only the ceremony's apply writes that marker (`utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts`), and the registered 18.0 command is the refusing `MigrateOrganizationOwnership`, so 18.0 records no verified run and the drops stay withheld on a v17-shaped database. The page says so.
- **The refusal code is `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`.** `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE_CODE = 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED'` (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/organization-ownership.ts:1115`). `MigrateOrganizationOwnership.run()` (`:1147`) answers `error: plan_refused | apply_refused`, `reason: upgrade-unavailable`, `code: NOT_IMPLEMENTED` and `detail` under `--json`, otherwise the message plus `(NOT_IMPLEMENTED)`, exit 1, before it opens anything. Its flags are plain strings, so parsing reads no file. The page's "exits `1` with `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (under `--json`, `code` beside `error`) and reads and writes nothing" was already right and is kept.

## Dispatch hypotheses

1. **`os dev` on a v17-shaped database at `BASE`: the step still runs, and it refuses.** The `recover` hook in `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` calls `upgradeDevelopmentDatabase` (`utils/dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.ts`). For a local SQLite file it copies the file and its `telemetry` sibling into the backups directory, then spawns `migrate organization-ownership --dev --database-url URL --out PLAN`. The registered 18.0 command refuses that with `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` and writes no plan. `os dev` then prints the refusal, "The upgrade plan was refused, and nothing was changed", where the copy is, and the 18.0 sentence, and exits with the refused child's code. The apply step is never reached. For any other database it takes no copy, runs nothing, and prints the 18.0 sentence. The callout now says this. Measured from source and from `src/utils/dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.test.ts`: 6 of 6 passed, and its refused-plan case asserts one call, "nothing was changed", the copy's location, "17.x release" and no `--plan-file`. Not run live: this is a docs-only card, and a live run needs the CLI's dependency closure built (63 build tasks, 49 cache misses at this base).
2. **Docs gates reading the fence: falsified, because no gate reads it.** `check:cli-examples-parity` compares one declared pair only (`os package publish`; `--list` prints "1 row(s) read"), and `check-cli-command-ids` keeps out of `content/docs` by its own header. The qualified fence names only flags the registered command declares, inherited from the ceremony class. All 45 derived gates exit 0 with the fence in place.
3. **The release page states the rule: falsified.** `content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx` has no hit for "fresh install", "17.x release" or "upgrade path". So the (a) passages carry the sentence, and the two permissions pages link to the CLI page's `os migrate organization-ownership` callout rather than restate it again. The release page is not touched.

## Overlap with an open PR

Open draft PR #24667 (the 18.x walled lift) rewrites the first line of both `cli.mdx` callouts and the `:1205` table row. This diff leaves those three lines byte-identical and puts the 18.0 sentence and the 18.x qualifier on the lines after them. I applied #24667's three hunks to `BASE` as a scratch commit and trial-merged it with this head: `git merge-tree --write-tree` exit 0, a tree id, no conflict. Control leg: the same against this branch's first commit (`5da97c5952`), which edited those lines, exit 1 with `CONFLICT (content)`. `cli.mdx` has no merge driver (`git check-attr merge`: unspecified), so the local reading is the one GitHub makes.

## Tests and gates (head `d989786746`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (no paths): 4 paths, 57 changed lines (+39 / -18) against merge base `bfc1539fe`, 45 commands (31 pnpm, 14 node). **All 45 exit 0**, with each exit code captured before any pipe. The `--ran` reconciliation: `Run reconciliation — 45 derived, 45 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.`
  - At the first head (`5da97c5952`), five first attempts exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples` and `check:docs-transcript-drift` (no `dist`), and `check:docs` exited 1 (`packages/spec/json-schema` missing). They measured nothing. After `turbo run build` of `spec`, `lint`, `formula` and `sdui-parser` (4 cache hits), then `core`, `client` and `client-react`, all five re-ran exit 0. At `d989786746` every one of the 45 exited 0 on its first attempt.
  - Verdict lines: `✓ check-cli-examples-parity: 1 declared pair(s) agree as SETS` · `✅ check-doc-anchors: 538 internal #fragment link(s) across 423 source file(s) all resolve to a real heading` · `✓ check-docs-transcript-drift: 4 declared transcript value(s) across 417 page(s)` · `✓ content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx: the overlay whitelist table AND the counts in the sentence under it agree with DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` · `✅ 227 generated files in sync with packages/spec` · `check-nul-bytes: OK`.
- I compiled the four pages with `@mdx-js/mdx` 3.1.1 and `remark-gfm`: 4 OK. Negative control (an unclosed expression): FAIL, exit 1. CI's `Build Docs` is the authority here.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.test.ts` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `Tests 6 passed (6)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. This is the measurement for hypothesis 1, not a test of this diff.
- The control-byte self-scan of the four files found none.
- No ablation and no reverse verification: this is docs prose, and no tested behaviour changed.
- Left to CI: the full farm, `pnpm lint`, the 11 declared-wide families, `Build Docs` and `Test Core`.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`. No published package ships `content/docs`. No `files[]` entry in any non-private workspace `package.json` names `content`, `docs` or a parent path: 0 hits, with a positive control (a `dist` entry) at 73 packages. `apps/docs` is private.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx:415–419` says "an 18.x `os serve` refuses to start on a database still holding one until the v18 migration ceremony (ADR-0131 C7) has carried it to the environment layer", with no 18.0 sentence. It is the twin of the metadata-lifecycle note above. It names no command, so the card's census does not reach it, and it is outside this claim's file surface, so it is not edited here. Reported to the seat for the #24637 family.
- `cli.mdx:1205`, the command table row, already says "In 18.0 the command refuses" and names no plan or apply invocation. It is not a census hit and is not edited (see the overlap above).
- When #24667's wording lands, the `os dev` callout's first line will say "Until then the ceremony refuses", and the lines after it will still say what 18.0 does. The two read together.
